operator_architecture.branch_input: Gaussian spatial source profile at fixed 12x12 sensors
operator_architecture.LF_feature_mesh: 11x11 spatial mesh x 4 times; 5x5x3 subset used in nonlinear branch

design: LF upwind on 21x21; HF central on 129x129.

target_LF_vs_HF.note: Diagnostic-only target solve; not included in LF operator training or validation.

resolution_only_Central21_vs_Central129.note: Diagnostic-only Central 21x21 vs HF Central 129x129 resolution-control gap; not used in training.

same_grid_LF_scheme_effect.note: Diagnostic-only comparison of Upwind and Central advection on identical 21x21 nodes; not used in training.

scheme_diagnostics.warning: Central advection has no first-order upwind artificial diffusion, but it is not exact and may show dispersive/oscillatory error at high cell Peclet number. Upwind modified-equation diffusion is a leading-order estimate.

note: The target source theta_true is excluded from the LF function ensemble.
